# Talos retrospective — `screen-ruler`

> Generated by Talos for `screen-ruler` from `docs/prompts/retrospective.md`; re-run `talos sync` to refresh it. Edits here are overwritten.

**Arguments:** the text typed after the command — `--bootstrap` to derive a first `docs/INVARIANTS.md` from the repository itself, or `--since <PR>` to set the window explicitly. With neither, the window is the retrospective marker at the end of `docs/INVARIANTS.md`, or the last five merged pull requests.

**Procedure:** read [`.github/skills/talos-retro/SKILL.md`](../skills/talos-retro/SKILL.md) in full, then its reference [`.github/skills/talos-retro/references/talos-retro.md`](../skills/talos-retro/references/talos-retro.md), and follow them: they are the complete prompt and this repository's amendments to it, and this file only launches them.
